releases.notes:
## Container Crafting 1.0.0 for Minecraft 26.3

Shows a 2x2 crafting grid and result slot in a panel to the left of chests, barrels, shulker boxes and hoppers. Crafting runs on the server.

**Server:** required. **Client:** optional. The grid only appears when both sides have the mod. A vanilla client on a modded server, or a modded client on a vanilla server, gets normal containers.

### Dependencies

| Dependency | Version |
| --- | --- |
| Minecraft | 26.3 |
| [Fabric Loader](https://fabricmc.net/use/) | 0.19.5 or newer |
| [Fabric API](https://modrinth.com/mod/fabric-api) | any for 26.3 (built against 0.162.0+26.3) |
| [Fabric Language Kotlin](https://modrinth.com/mod/fabric-language-kotlin) | any (built against 1.14.2+kotlin.2.4.21) |

Install all of these on the server. On a client that wants the grid, install them too.
